title: Boxed Water
body:
"Mmmmmm, a box of water. YOUR ABLE TO SWIM WITH THIS! *caution* we are not liable for death and injury"

Description

Boxed Water is a structure purchasable at Illumine Designs for $1,320

When placed on the property, It takes the appearance of a blue transparent cube that can be scaled up to 15x15 studs.

It has the same functionality as water around the map, forcing your character into swimming when entered, but unlike regular water, Boxed Water does not take your oxygen away, making it unable to actually kill.

Trivia

  • When initially added, Boxed Water could actually drown you, making it possible to make traps on your property.
